figures.sourceHomographLimits: The contextual word is represented here as Cyrillic Свет, consistent with the reused transcription and separate source translation line. Pixels alone do not establish Unicode identity: the initial C-shaped glyph can resemble Latin C, and handwritten Cyrillic forms must not be silently transliterated into Latin lookalikes. This is source-pixel retention, not approval for cultural text in a modern figure. No numeric calibration or exact tick count is inferred.

sourceInventory: One rectangular unbranched schematic loop: left vertical wire, top horizontal wire, right vertical component/connections and bottom horizontal wire.

figures.sourceHomographLimits: The top C-shaped glyph cannot by pixels alone distinguish Latin C from Cyrillic С. The bottom label is epsilon-form; no exact Unicode epsilon variant or modern glyph normalization is certified. The source review approves the printed forms, not a guessed codepoint mapping.
